as_told.title: The Typhoon submarine appears as McMoneagle described it

plain: In 1979 a psychic spy named Joe McMoneagle is said to have used remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe a faraway place with the mind alone, to see a huge new submarine being built at a Soviet shipyard on the White Sea. Paul Smith, who served in the government's psychic spy program, tells this twice on the show as something he heard from McMoneagle. Smith says that "eight months after" the sessions, "the Russians floated out the Typhoon, the biggest submarine ever built", and that details such as where its missile tubes sat matched the sessions. If true, it would show the mind could gather real spy intelligence.
